question: On the same fixtures does actual official starting-XI continuity and prior-three league starts improve score and 1X2 predictions beyond the identical team-only model?

sources.generic_engine_source: K League 2 preregistered candidate at commit 7ba2ce8cfccd3e097014f95ba3b03560870d2f9a; copied generic engine only, no parameter/selection/results transfer

cohort: 2025 official regular K1 228 + 2026 official FE/Y 204 = 432 actual XI/result rows; 2026 other 24 unfinished excluded; exact official ID, teams, date, score; 90 minutes plus stoppage; refuse ET/PK/playoff/refund and ambiguous product. User prices are full-game 3-way, source period source contract and Betman settlement codes 0/1/2. Archived prices are not proven pregame or executable.
feature: Own/opponent current XI intersect prior earlier-calendar-day official league XI / 11 and sum of current XI starts in prior three completed league fixtures / 11, each with absence-of-history indicators. Only XI and IDs, no target scores, target minutes, goals, substitutions, injury, fatigue or formation. Same-day team history with multiple games excluded. Unknown team effect zero; prior team/cup/national-team workload and transfers incomplete.
model: Both independent Poisson home/away, common intercept+home effect and team attack+conceded strength; candidate adds eight symmetric lineup features. Penalty alpha/2 squared non-intercept; fixed 180 day half-life anchored at training cutoff; L-BFGS-B maxiter3000 ftol1e-12 gtol1e-7. Alpha grid {1,10,100} separately per model; minimize validation joint score NLL, ties smaller alpha.
time_split: 2025 train. Validation 2026-01-01..2026-06-30, but selection/refit may use only dates <=2026-06-24 inclusive (2026-07-01 minus 7 days); June25-30 withheld as embargo if any. 2025 fitting cutoff 2025-12-25 inclusive (2026-01-01 minus7); 2026 test starts 2026-07-01. One train+eligible-validation refit only, test predictions and parameters and IDs frozen before score. Prior XI history strictly earlier calendar date, excluding all team same-day multiple fixtures.
evaluation: 1X2 model coverage/accuracy/logloss/Brier on test full labeled cohort; candidate/team/normalized 1/odds market on identical complete eligible 1X2 price subcohort and argmax tie home/draw/away; 1-unit no-fee ROI, monthly net, daily-close drawdown, changed picks; paired calendar-week bootstrap 2000 resamples seed20261103 descriptive only. Report no true tipster, 9:1, operating frozen replay. Record missing price, XI history, unseen team and excluded cases.
integrity: No test outcome read during alpha selection or prediction freeze; testing uses synthetic poison and availability checks. Exact raw input hashes, fixture IDs, probabilities, model parameters and training cutoff committed prior to scoring. Independently reconcile Decimal payoff. Git blob and independent checkout bytes match. Previously inspected 2026 and source receipt timings unverified; not independent blind or proof of executable price.
non_goals: No performance search beyond specified grid, no operating model, bet, wallet, DB, scheduler, merge or deployment.
